items.why: One question with three answers is the thing that cost most time building the pattern.
A consumer loses content to a clipping ancestor with no message at all; the check already exists here.
A zero-tolerance gate that fails once in ten runs teaches a reader to re-run it.
Every page a consumer composes from CardGroup bleeds to the window edge until they guess the fix.
Two controls with one label, and a prop that reaches one of them.
A documented commit rule that no gate checks, which is this branch's own recurring class.
